description: STL 3D model viewer for the Cardputer Zero: browse, open and inspect binary or ASCII STL files on the 320x170 screen.

store.summary: Pocket STL 3D viewer: browse, open and inspect models on the Cardputer Zero
store.description:
KanSTL is a pocket 3D model viewer: open an STL file from the built-in file browser and rotate it on the 320x170 screen. The renderer, the file browser and the pixel UI are original code with no LVGL or 3D engine behind them.

FEATURES
- In-app file browser: folders, file sizes, load errors, and the last directory is remembered
- Binary and ASCII STL; models are centred and fitted to the viewport automatically
- Four render styles on one key: SOLID, EDGES (dark creases plus a bright silhouette), MATCAP (metallic shading with a specular highlight) and WIREFRAME
- Arrow keys rotate, Enter / Space zoom, Alt + arrows move the rotation centre, R / 0 reset the view
- Auto-rotate around X, Y or the model's own Z axis; hold 6 for 0.6 s to stop it
- XYZ orientation gizmo, triangle count and live frame rate in the status bar
- Esc only exits after a deliberate 3 second hold, with an on-screen progress bar
- Runs as the normal user under APPLaunch; no root, no background service

SPEED ON THE DEVICE
- 12k triangles: about 8 ms per frame
- 1.9M triangles: about 1 second per frame (works, but EDGES is skipped above 500k triangles to stay inside the memory budget)

NOTES
- Models are read from the device filesystem; put STL files in /home/pi/models (or anywhere the file browser can reach) over SSH or a USB stick.
- No network access is used.

zh-CN.summary: 口袋 STL 3D 模型查看器：在 Cardputer Zero 上浏览、打开、旋转模型
zh-CN.description:
KanSTL 是一个口袋 3D 模型查看器：在内置文件浏览器里打开 STL 文件，然后在 320×170 的屏幕上旋转查看。渲染器、文件浏览器和像素 UI 都是自己写的代码，不依赖 LVGL，也没有 3D 引擎。

功能
- 内置文件浏览器：文件夹、文件大小、加载错误提示，会记住上次的目录
- 支持二进制与 ASCII STL；模型自动居中并适配视口
- 四种渲染风格一键循环：SOLID、EDGES（深色折痕 + 亮色轮廓）、MATCAP（金属质感 + 高光）、WIREFRAME
- 方向键旋转，Enter / Space 缩放，Alt + 方向键移动旋转中心，R / 0 复位
- 可绕 X、Y 或模型自身 Z 轴自动旋转；长按 6 键 0.6 秒停止
- 右上角 XYZ 方向指示，状态栏显示三角面数量和实时帧率
- 退出需要长按 Esc 3 秒，屏幕上有进度条
- 以普通用户身份在 APPLaunch 下运行，不需要 root，也不安装后台服务

设备上的速度
- 12k 三角面：约 8 ms 一帧
- 190 万三角面：约 1 秒一帧（能打开，但超过 50 万面时会跳过 EDGES，以免超出内存）

说明
- 模型从设备文件系统读取：可以通过 SSH 或 U 盘把 STL 放进 /home/pi/models（或文件浏览器能到达的任意目录）。
- 不使用网络。
